item.title: Lindsay Clancy jury fails to reach a consensus on sixth day of deliberations
item.description: There was drama in the courtroom Thursday in the trial of the Massachusetts mother charged with murdering her three children. The jury has been trying to reach consensus for six days.

item.title: International forecasters warn countries need to be prepared for a powerful El Niño
item.description: Forecasters are expecting the El Niño weather pattern to strengthen significantly this year, raising the risks of extreme weather around the world well into 2027.
item.content:encoded: Forecasters are expecting the El Niño weather pattern to strengthen significantly this year, raising the risks of extreme weather around the world well into 2027.

item.title: Why the U.S. Treasury is buying back double the government bonds it normally does
item.description: The U.S. Treasury is planning to buy back at least double the long-dated government bonds it usually does. Will the plan pit the Treasury secretary against both the bond markets and the Fed?
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Treasury is planning to buy back at least double the long-dated government bonds it usually does. Will the plan pit the Treasury secretary against both the bond markets and the Fed?

item.title: Gloria Steinem helped shape the classic children's album 'Free to Be... You and Me'
item.description: Through Ms. Magazine, the late activist and author Gloria Steinem was one of the driving forces behind one of the most classic children's albums, Free to Be... You and Me from 1972.

item.description: Republicans see immigration as a winning issue ahead of the midterms as President Trump's administration ramps up arrests and deportations.

item.title: As El Niño intensifies, Rio turns to science — and a spiritual adviser
item.description: This year's Super El Niño has brought unprecedented weather to Rio de Janeiro. Unaccustomed to tornado-strength winds, the city found an unusual partner to combat the weather: a spiritual adviser.
item.content:encoded: This year's Super El Niño has brought unprecedented weather to Rio de Janeiro. Unaccustomed to tornado-strength winds, the city found an unusual partner to combat the weather: a spiritual adviser.

item.title: Nepali community in Texas grieves and prays for healing after flash floods
item.description: Nepalese groups in North Texas, which has one of the largest communities of people from Nepal in the U.S., continue to grieve the loss of hundreds of people after the devastating floods in August.

item.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with filmmaker Abigail Disney about her friendship with Gloria Steinem and the legacy her friend leaves behind.

item.title: Gloria Steinem in her own words

item.title: Swing voters say Trump hasn't delivered on his promise to lower prices
